table_title: List the 15 leading global causes of death in 2021 per WHO Global Health Estimates (GHE) 2021, all-age all-sex aggregate. Universe filter: WHO Global Health Estimates 2021 (Deaths by Cause, Age, Sex, by Country and by Region, 2000–2021) ranked by estimated global deaths DESC, top-15. For each cause, give the Rank (1-15), Estimated Deaths 2021 in millions (6-decimal precision per WHO workbook), and WHO Cause Group (closed 3-value categorical: Group I: Communicable, maternal, perinatal and nutritional conditions / Group II: Noncommunicable diseases / Group III: Injuries). Per cycle-1 audit's required staging edits, top-15 chosen over top-10 because (a) WHO GHE workbook publishes Top20 sheet with deterministic ranking, (b) top-15 provides row-count headroom above the 10-row gate, and (c) top-15 introduces the Injuries category via Road injury (rank 14) — top-10 would have been all Group I + Group II only.
db_analog: WITH top_15 AS (SELECT cause_of_death, estimated_deaths_2021_millions, who_cause_group, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY estimated_deaths_2021_millions DESC) AS rank FROM who_ghe_2021_global_all_age_all_sex ORDER BY estimated_deaths_2021_millions DESC LIMIT 15) SELECT cause_of_death, rank, estimated_deaths_2021_millions, who_cause_group FROM top_15 ORDER BY rank ASC
temporal_note: WHO Global Health Estimates 2021 (Deaths by Cause, Age, Sex, by Country and by Region, 2000–2021), accessed via cycle-1 audit's master-derived dump on 2026-05-19. Universe is the closed top-15 leading global causes of death by 2021 estimated deaths per WHO GHE workbook (all-age all-sex aggregate). Year-lock 2021 — WHO publishes GHE updates every few years; when 2022+ data becomes available, instance can be re-staged (temporal_sensitivity=medium reflects this). source_count = 1 registered (WHO GHE 2021 — universe + value role for all 4 cells per cycle-1 audit's source plan). Per-row cells: Cause of Death name verbatim from WHO GHE workbook cause labels (e.g., 'Ischaemic heart disease', 'Trachea, bronchus, lung cancers', 'Alzheimer disease and other dementias' — note WHO uses 'Alzheimer disease' NOT 'Alzheimer's disease' per ICD-style convention); Rank integer 1-15 per DESC ranking by estimated deaths; Estimated Deaths 2021 (millions) at 6-decimal precision per WHO workbook (e.g., 9.033116 for #1 Ischaemic heart disease); WHO Cause Group per WHO classification taxonomy (closed 3-value: Group I: Communicable, maternal, perinatal and nutritional conditions / Group II: Noncommunicable diseases / Group III: Injuries). Cycle-1 audit's required edits applied at cycle-0: (1) row count = top-15 (NOT top-10 — provides headroom + introduces Injuries category via Road injury rank 14); (2) instance renamed to who_global_top_15_leading_causes_of_death_2021 (was who_global_top_10_*); (3) 4-col schema (Communicable/Noncommunicable binary dropped — duplicates 3-group classification); (4) gt_construction = web_search_who (analog to web_search_faostat); (5) Domain = Health/Public Health (with space, NOT hyphen — per domain_taxonomy.md spelling).
_extraction_notes: Top_k instance — closed canonical top-15 WHO GHE 2021 global leading causes of death universe ordered by Rank ASC (= Estimated Deaths DESC). Single PK Cause of Death (cause labels unique within the 15-entry universe per WHO GHE taxonomy). **Chips Health crisis-light family from 1 to 2 instances** — Health/Public Health NEW subdomain (current Health is only Health/Epidemiology via `disease_outbreak_response_by_country_or_region`); brings benchmark to **only Health crisis-light family fully chipped to 2 (Food was just chipped this session; Environment and Law chipped earlier; Health is the LAST crisis-light family chip)**. NEW `abstract-categories/causes-of-death` fine-class extending abstract-categories bucket from 7 to 8 instances (joining music-genres, religions×2, languages, philosophical-schools, architectural-styles, chemical-groups). top_k was 6/5 over-target under old target 84; under raised target 102 ceiling will be re-positioned. Source plan: 1 registered source (WHO GHE 2021 publication — universe + value role for all 4 cells per cycle-1 audit's source plan). Mirror precedent for source_count=1 master-only validation: `top_15_most_produced_crops_by_global_production` (FAOSTAT, source_count=1, gt_construction=web_search_faostat). claim_type = source_defined per WHO GHE 2021 closed canonical authoritative ranking; benchmark-window scope locked to 2021 release. Cycle arc: 1 round of pre-staging design review (cycle-1 'Approve With Required Edits' — top-10→top-15, schema 5→4 col, gt_construction web_search_who, Domain Health/Public Health spelling, audit's verbatim 15-row dump). All 5 cycle-1 staging edits applied at cycle-0 using audit's master-derived dump verbatim — 60 cell values (15 rows × 4 cols) committed WHO-verbatim with NO best-guess values. **gt_construction = web_search_who** — second pkdb_bench instance to use non-Wikipedia external-source vocabulary (first was `top_15_most_produced_crops_by_global_production` with web_search_faostat). Confidence gradient: very-LLM-knowable include #1 Ischaemic heart disease (always #1 in WHO rankings), #2 COVID-19 (pandemic-era 2021 dominant), #3 Stroke, #4 COPD, #6 Lung cancers; mid-difficulty include #7 Alzheimer disease and other dementias (note WHO uses 'Alzheimer' NOT 'Alzheimer's' — possessive dropped per ICD convention), #5 Lower respiratory infections (which became Group I leading cause post-pandemic), #8 Diabetes; harder calibration include #9 Kidney diseases (NOT Neonatal conditions which was cycle-1 preview wrong), #14 Road injury (only Group III: Injuries row — would be missed if top-10), #11 Hypertensive heart disease (distinct from Ischaemic heart disease #1), #12 Cirrhosis of the liver, #15 Colon and rectum cancers (combined-organ cancer label). Top_k category-fit: per the top_k category contract, the row universe is a top-N ranking by a numeric attribute (Estimated Deaths 2021); mirror precedent `largest_asteroids_with_geometric_mean_diameter_above_250_km` (top-N by diameter), `tennis_players_with_more_than_5_grand_slam_singles_titles` (threshold-N by titles), `worlds_largest_container_ports_by_2024_teu` (top-N by TEU). Chips top_k under raised target 102 ceiling (was over-target under 84). The WHO Cause Group cell adds a closed 3-value categorical dimension useful for benchmark calibration tests (does the model correctly distinguish Group II NCD from Group I communicable for ambiguous causes like 'Lower respiratory infections' which is Group I but easily mistaken for Group II respiratory NCD?). Saturates Health crisis-light family chip — only Health remains as crisis-light family at 1 instance before this; now Health joins Food / Law / Environment as crisis-light-family-chipped-to-2.
